title: Recognising Ground Under Repair
question: Which area is most likely to be marked as 'ground under repair' where you may get relief?

choices.text: A blue-marked area with piles of grass cuttings
A patch of bare earth not marked by anything
A normal bunker filled with sand
A spot of wet grass after rain

explanation: Ground under repair is usually marked with lines or stakes (commonly blue or white) and can include areas with piled grass from maintenance.
imagePrompt: A teen boy golfer is next to an area surrounded by blue stakes containing grass cuttings, identifying ground under repair.
imageAlt: Teen golfer beside marked ground under repair with piles of grass.
